input.scenario: Conforming entitlement record for: Purchase or entitlement never creates installation, deployment, system, application or usage; provenance indicating such derivation is invalid.
Entitlement record violates: Purchase or entitlement never creates installation, deployment, system, application or usage; provenance indicating such derivation is invalid.
Conforming entitlement record for: Every entitlement references one authoritative agreement and one WM-SFT-001 product scope with declared scopeGranularity.
Entitlement record violates: Every entitlement references one authoritative agreement and one WM-SFT-001 product scope with declared scopeGranularity.
Conforming entitlement record for: scopeGranularity is product, edition, release-family or release and the referenced identity remains mastered by WM-SFT-001.
Entitlement record violates: scopeGranularity is product, edition, release-family or release and the referenced identity remains mastered by WM-SFT-001.
Conforming entitlement record for: Licence metric, quantity, territory, term and permitted-use constraints are effective-dated and historically resolvable.
Entitlement record violates: Licence metric, quantity, territory, term and permitted-use constraints are effective-dated and historically resolvable.
Conforming entitlement record for: EntitlementAllocation uses one typed consumerBinding of organization, software-system or business-application and has no redundant consumer fields.
Entitlement record violates: EntitlementAllocation uses one typed consumerBinding of organization, software-system or business-application and has no redundant consumer fields.

Conforming entitlement record for: At instant t, allocated quantity is the sum over active or provisioned allocations whose effective window covers t; the sum cannot exceed the entitlement effective at t under the same metric.

Entitlement record violates: At instant t, allocated quantity is the sum over active or provisioned allocations whose effective window covers t; the sum cannot exceed the entitlement effective at t under the same metric.
Conforming entitlement record for: Reallocation closes or reduces predecessor allocations and conserves quantity before successor allocations become effective.
Entitlement record violates: Reallocation closes or reduces predecessor allocations and conserves quantity before successor allocations become effective.
Conforming entitlement record for: Assignment changes entitlement consumption without changing product, system or application identity.
Entitlement record violates: Assignment changes entitlement consumption without changing product, system or application identity.
Conforming entitlement record for: Product upgrade eligibility never rewrites historical product scope; it creates a successor entitlement revision.
Entitlement record violates: Product upgrade eligibility never rewrites historical product scope; it creates a successor entitlement revision.
Conforming entitlement record for: Suspension, expiry and termination stop effective authorization but preserve commercial and compliance history.
Entitlement record violates: Suspension, expiry and termination stop effective authorization but preserve commercial and compliance history.
Conforming entitlement record for: Renewal creates one successor entitlement revision linked by successorRef; an expired record is never silently extended.
Entitlement record violates: Renewal creates one successor entitlement revision linked by successorRef; an expired record is never silently extended.
Conforming entitlement record for: Observed use and compliance verdicts remain external evidence and never mutate entitlement state by inference.
Entitlement record violates: Observed use and compliance verdicts remain external evidence and never mutate entitlement state by inference.
Conforming entitlement record for: Hosted delivery may have entitlement and usage without local installation and records the absence explicitly.
Entitlement record violates: Hosted delivery may have entitlement and usage without local installation and records the absence explicitly.
Conforming entitlement record for: Agreement duties and surviving restrictions remain externally mastered after entitlement termination.
Entitlement record violates: Agreement duties and surviving restrictions remain externally mastered after entitlement termination.
Conforming entitlement record for: Territory or permitted-use breach is a compliance finding and never silently expands entitlement scope.
Entitlement record violates: Territory or permitted-use breach is a compliance finding and never silently expands entitlement scope.
Conforming entitlement record for: Retired entitlement and allocation identifiers remain resolvable and are never recycled.
Entitlement record violates: Retired entitlement and allocation identifiers remain resolvable and are never recycled.

cases.expect: Reject over-allocation; do not merely flag it.
Accept reallocation with conserved quantity and closed predecessor interval.
Create exactly one successor revision; preserve ent-1.
